description: Reported from tutorial T2 'Musterin' da Boyz': pressing the phase-action button (pad ☰ or mouse) ended the Deployment phase outright while the Gretchin were still undeployed, dropping the player into the 'Who takes the first turn?' roll-off with no way back. Root cause was Main._on_deployment_confirmed falling back to PhaseManager.advance_to_next_phase() whenever the END_DEPLOYMENT action was REJECTED — walking straight past the very check that had just refused it. This scenario proves the whole player path now holds the phase: the button is disabled, the entry point refuses to open the summary dialog and names the blocking units, the dialog's own confirm callback no longer force-advances, and the pad ☰ chip promises 'Confirm Unit' (not 'Confirm / End') while a fully-placed unit awaits confirmation.

steps.script:
InputDeviceManager.claim_pad()
var dc = node.deployment_controller
dc.begin_deploy("U_WAZBOM_BLASTAJET")
var poly = BoardState.get_deployment_zone_for_player(GameState.get_active_player())
var cx = 0.0
var cy = 0.0
for p in poly:
	cx += p.x
	cy += p.y
cx /= max(1, poly.size())
cy /= max(1, poly.size())
var guard = 0
while dc.is_placing() and dc.get_placed_count() < dc.get_total_model_count() and guard < 12:
	dc.try_place_at(Vector2(cx, cy - guard * 70.0))
	guard += 1
return dc.get_placed_count() >= dc.get_total_model_count() and dc.get_total_model_count() > 0
